name: JCU Access Fund (scholarship, bursary and support grant)
summary: Up to $5,000 for new full-time JCU undergraduates facing ongoing financial hardship, with smaller awards for second-years.
key: The JCU Access Scholarship is valued at $5,000, the Access Bursary at $2,000 and the Support Grant at $1,000.
who: A new commencing first-year student in an undergraduate diploma or bachelor course, or a second-year bachelor student for the Support Grant.
Enrolled full-time and experiencing ongoing financial hardship.
how: Apply online and upload proof of income and at least two months of bank statements.
catches: The 2026 round opened 25 August and closed at midday on 2 October 2026. Check for the next round.
